essence: The verse names covering and veiling as declared and spoken.
One should speak welcome and a welfare question before the deity.
The mouth rinse is said to be made with born clove and cardamom.
Arghya is called so from the giving of invaluable fruit.
The eight-limbed arghya is proclaimed with barley, fragrance, fruit, and flower.
